question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus these SDK token-budget helpers as the stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold this token-budget signal into the broader assemble metadata work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: The branch widens a public plugin API and SDK export surface that third-party context engines may adopt, while a broader assemble metadata RFC remains open and current proof is not a live scenario.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve this API shape, require the SDK baseline hash update, and wait for redacted real long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Broader RFC
options.body: Pause or close this PR and handle token headroom together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Avoid new SDK exports until maintainers settle which token-budget helper contract should be supported publicly.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve this API shape, require the SDK baseline hash update, and wait for redacted real long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and have the strongest recent history on the context-engine lifecycle and assemble-budget path.
